caption:
🚇 A typical weekday on the Mexico City Metro.

Twelve lines, opened in 1969, carrying one of the busiest metro systems in the world. Every line starts at once at 5 a.m. Each dot is a train following the real track, in its line colour, generated from the published service frequencies.

📊 Data: CDMX open data GTFS (published frequencies), via Mobility Database.
🛰️ Imagery: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2023 by EOX (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
